nad5506e361.headline: KRA Introduces the VAT Pre-Populated Return System - Ghetto Radio
nad5506e361.summary: Kenya Revenue Authority is introducing a pre-populated VAT return filing system for the November 2024 tax period, using data from iTax and TIMS to automate return preparation.
nad5506e361.why: The Kenya Revenue Authority administers taxes in Kenya, and changes to VAT filing affect compliance costs for businesses there.

source.name: Ghetto Radio - Kenya's Number 1 Ghetto Radio

sources.name: Ghetto Radio - Kenya's Number 1 Ghetto Radio

n1d6e815a05.headline: What a Ukraine peace plan could look like
n1d6e815a05.summary: Diplomats and leaders in Moscow, Kyiv, Brussels, Washington and other capitals are working behind closed doors on what a Ukraine peace plan could contain.
n1d6e815a05.why: Ukraine war outcomes affect European energy, grain and defence spending, and sanctions on Russia shape global commodity flows.

n139038ed86.headline: Kedipes state aid repayment hits €1.47 billion
n139038ed86.summary: State-owned asset management company Kedipes has repaid €1.47 billion in state aid since starting operations in September 2018, including €310 million in 2024.
n139038ed86.why: Kedipes is Cyprus's state-owned asset management company, and its repayments reflect the management of legacy bank-related state support.

nab4f346394.headline: Cooking Gas And CNG Equipment Are Exempt From Import Duties - Customs
nab4f346394.summary: Nigerian customs has said cooking gas and CNG equipment are exempt from import duties.
nab4f346394.why: Import duty exemptions change the cost of imported energy products, affecting consumer fuel prices and importers.

n51abc24114.headline: G20 watchdog calls for addressing risks
n51abc24114.summary: The G20's financial watchdog says growth in the non-bank sector can pose substantial risks to financial stability.
n51abc24114.why: The Financial Stability Board coordinates global financial regulation, and its warnings on non-bank lenders shape supervisory priorities for funds and private credit.

nbe7e72d21a.headline: SEB to move Baltic headquarters to Tallinn in a blow to Lithuania
nbe7e72d21a.summary: Swedish-owned SEB Bank plans to consolidate its three Baltic banks with headquarters in Tallinn, Estonia, a move that is a blow to Lithuania.
nbe7e72d21a.why: SEB is a Nordic bank with a large Baltic franchise, and changes to its regional structure affect its operations and local banking markets.

n43616cf0ef.headline: Full list of water firms and price hikes revealed - as bills set to rise by over 50%
n43616cf0ef.summary: A full list of water companies and price increases has been published, with bills set to rise by more than 50% in some areas. Campaigners are calling for action.
n43616cf0ef.why: Water utility tariffs are regulated in England and Wales and influence household costs, company revenues and the financing needs of regulated water utilities.

nf4dfdafcbf.headline: Top creditor China has not approved any loans to Cambodia so far this year, data shows
nf4dfdafcbf.summary: Data shows China, Cambodia's top creditor, has not approved any loans to Cambodia so far this year. The data covers the current year to date.
nf4dfdafcbf.why: China is a major lender to Cambodia, so changes in its lending affect the country's infrastructure funding and fiscal financing.

n12bae2f8a2.headline: FOS takes over RTC and grows in information technology
n12bae2f8a2.summary: FOS Spa signed a framework agreement to acquire the entire share capital of RTC Spa, an SME based in the province of Verona that operates in information technology.
n12bae2f8a2.why: FOS is an Italian company, and acquisitions of small IT services firms like RTC are typical of consolidation within Italy's technology services sector.

n9e40147de4.headline: Mortgage-holders in limbo over future interest-rate cuts, experts warn
n9e40147de4.summary: Experts warn that mortgage holders are in limbo over future interest rate cuts. Uncertainty is blamed on the Budget increase in employers' national insurance contributions.
n9e40147de4.why: Mortgage rates depend on Bank of England policy expectations, which shape household spending and UK housing demand.

n0fa3fc4974.headline: Anger over water bills hike which campaigners say will not solve sewage crisis
n0fa3fc4974.summary: Campaigners called a settlement for water companies a travesty, as water bills rise. They say the deal will not solve the sewage crisis, and customers face higher costs.
n0fa3fc4974.why: UK water companies are regulated utilities whose settlements with the regulator determine bills and investment. Regulatory outcomes affect their revenues and debt.

n0659fd1965.headline: Nasdaq Index outlook: Have tech giants exceeded the limits of the Nasdaq 100?
n0659fd1965.summary: An analysis asks whether dominant tech companies have exceeded the limits of the Nasdaq-100 index. It covers the regulatory dilemma and the rebalancing efforts around the index.
n0659fd1965.why: The Nasdaq-100 tracks the largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq, and its weighting rules affect index-linked funds holding these megacaps.

nf5dca76719.headline: Soges finalizes acquisition of Hotel Bretagna; shareholders approve aucap
nf5dca76719.summary: Soges Group announced it has finalized the acquisition of Hotel Bretagna Srl. Shareholders also authorized a EUR3.0 million capital increase.
nf5dca76719.why: Soges Group is an Italian listed company, and acquisitions and capital increases affect its balance sheet and growth plans.

n41e241acee.headline: Water bills set to rise by 40% due to water shortages
n41e241acee.summary: Water suppliers have revealed bill increases of around 40%, with the average household bill rising by £86. The rise is meant to address water pollution and shortages.
n41e241acee.why: UK water companies are regulated utilities whose tariffs are set under regulatory price controls. Bill changes affect household spending and regulated utility revenues.

n31f2271ce0.headline: Wesfarmers to Sell Coregas to Japan's Nippon Sanso for $480 Million
n31f2271ce0.summary: Wesfarmers said it has agreed to sell its Coregas business to a unit of Japan's Nippon Sanso Holdings for 770 million Australian dollars. Wesfarmers expects a pretax gain from the sale.
n31f2271ce0.why: Wesfarmers is a large Australian conglomerate with retail, chemicals and industrial holdings, so its portfolio sales can signal how it reshapes its businesses. Nippon Sanso is a Japanese industrial gases company.

impacts.name: Wesfarmers
impacts.why: Wesfarmers is the seller of the Coregas business and would receive the sale proceeds.

n2264e255ed.headline: Serco flags underlying profit growth, confidence in 2025
n2264e255ed.summary: Outsourcing group Serco forecast full-year revenue of £4.8bn in a Thursday update, in line with prior guidance, while reporting an organic revenue decline of 3%.
n2264e255ed.why: Serco is a UK-listed government and defence outsourcing contractor, so its revenue trends reflect public-sector spending.

ndc5f78d1ca.headline: The Fed is sounding more hawkish. Those voices may get louder in 2025.
ndc5f78d1ca.summary: New members of a powerful Federal Reserve committee gain voting power in January and could tip the central bank further toward fewer rate cuts, Yahoo Finance reports.
ndc5f78d1ca.why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, which influence borrowing costs, equity valuations and the dollar across global markets.

na7f57533e0.headline: USD/JPY Outlook: Fed Signals Fewer 2025 Cuts, BoJ Stays Silent
na7f57533e0.summary: The dollar-yen outlook turned sharply bullish after the Fed forecast fewer rate cuts in 2025. The Bank of Japan made no comment on its outlook.
na7f57533e0.why: The yen is a major funding and reserve currency, and USD/JPY reflects the interest-rate gap between the US and Japan. Shifts in Fed and BoJ policy expectations drive it.
na7f57533e0.why_moved: The Fed projected fewer rate cuts for 2025, while the Bank of Japan gave no signal on its own outlook. Narrower expected easing in the US supports the dollar against the yen.

n1661df9bc1.headline: TNC Daily Open: Markets Hit by Fewer Fed Cut Expectations
n1661df9bc1.summary: Markets fell as investors scaled back expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate cuts. The story is a daily market open update.
n1661df9bc1.why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, and changes in expected rate cuts shift bond yields, equity valuations and the dollar.
n1661df9bc1.why_moved: Markets declined as expectations for Federal Reserve rate cuts were reduced.

n6981271fe5.headline: Household water bills to rise by from April next year
n6981271fe5.summary: Household water bills in the UK are set to rise from April, with the increase significantly higher than the expected average rise of around £20 a year per household.
n6981271fe5.why: Water bills are set by the economic regulator Ofwat, and tariff decisions affect water companies' revenues, investment and regulatory standing.

n41a2e213e1.headline: TSX futures steady after stock sell-off on hawkish Fed decision
n41a2e213e1.summary: Futures tracking Canada's main index were steady on Thursday after stocks fell in the prior session when the US Federal Reserve forecast a slower pace of interest rate cuts next year.
n41a2e213e1.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark, and Federal Reserve rate expectations influence global equity and bond markets.
n41a2e213e1.why_moved: The US Federal Reserve forecast a slower pace of interest rate cuts next year, which hit stocks in the prior session.

nb5044b504a.headline: Data and Safety Monitoring Board Reviews Interim Safety Data of Phase 2 Subjects of OCU410 ArMaDa Clinical Trial for Geographic Atrophy Secondary to Dry Age-Related Macular Degeneration
nb5044b504a.summary: A Data and Safety Monitoring Board reviewed interim safety data for Phase 2 subjects in the OCU410 ArMaDa trial for geographic atrophy. No serious adverse events related to the study drug have been reported.
nb5044b504a.why: Clinical trial safety reviews are key milestones for drug developers, shaping the development path and investor expectations for experimental therapies.

n00560af342.headline: 2025 Budget: FG Earmarks N14.97trn For Security, Others
n00560af342.summary: The Nigerian federal government has earmarked N14.97 trillion for security and other items in the 2025 budget, according to Leadership Newspapers.
n00560af342.why: Government budgets set public spending and borrowing needs, which shape fiscal policy, inflation expectations and sovereign risk.

ncd11e2907e.headline: Twinza Oil Chairman welcomes Pasca Gas Agreement
ncd11e2907e.summary: The Pasca A Gas Project agreement was signed at Government House in Papua New Guinea, with Twinza Oil's chairman calling it a landmark milestone after 16 years in the country.
ncd11e2907e.why: Twinza Oil is a small oil and gas company, and gas project agreements determine development rights and future revenue for host governments and operators.

n8610ce065f.headline: Accenture Reports First-Quarter Fiscal 2025 Results
n8610ce065f.summary: Accenture reported first-quarter fiscal 2025 results with broad-based revenue growth across markets and industry groups. The company raised its fiscal 2025 revenue outlook and reported new bookings of $18.7 billion.
n8610ce065f.why: Accenture is a global IT services and consulting firm, and its bookings and guidance are closely watched as a gauge of corporate technology spending.

n212f8850ae.headline: Brookdale Improves 2025 Cash Flows by an Expected $15+ Million through Ventas Lease Amendment with Incremental Upside in 2026 and Beyond
n212f8850ae.summary: Brookdale Senior Living entered agreements with Ventas that are expected to improve 2025 cash flows by more than $15 million. The company also expects incremental upside in 2026 and beyond.
n212f8850ae.why: Brookdale operates senior living communities, and its lease terms with real estate owner Ventas directly affect its rent costs and cash generation.

n9be9a8df73.headline: GBP/USD Forecast: Dollar Surges Amid Hawkish FOMC
n9be9a8df73.summary: The GBP/USD outlook shows renewed dollar support despite the FOMC's rate cut. The Fed issued a hawkish statement on the pace of rate cuts in 2025.
n9be9a8df73.why: The Federal Reserve's policy rate sets the cost of dollar funding worldwide, so its guidance drives currency and bond market moves.
n9be9a8df73.why_moved: The Fed kept a hawkish stance on rate cuts for 2025 despite its rate cut, which supports the dollar against sterling.

n91a71d7cad.headline: Household water bills to rise by an average £31 a year from April
n91a71d7cad.summary: Household water bills will rise by an average of £31 a year from April, which is significantly higher than the expected average rise of around £20 a year.
n91a71d7cad.why: Water bills are set by regulators and affect household budgets and the regulated utility sector, which is watched closely by investors in UK infrastructure.

nb803b1b98a.headline: This is not our first defeat; we will assess what happened and learn from it – NAPO
nb803b1b98a.summary: Khurram Schehzad, Adviser to the Finance Minister, visited the Pakistan Stock Exchange at the invitation of its CEO, Farrukh Sabzwari, and held talks with top management.
nb803b1b98a.why: The Pakistan Stock Exchange is the country's main equity market, and government engagement with it can signal policy on capital markets.

ne770c71954.headline: Is Germany to blame for rising electricity prices in Europe?
ne770c71954.summary: DW examines claims that Germany is driving high electricity prices in other parts of Europe. It looks at how connected the European market is and the role of weather.
ne770c71954.why: Germany is a large power market linked to its neighbours through cross-border interconnectors. Power prices affect industrial costs, utilities and energy-intensive producers across Europe.

n3cf4318d23.headline: Unis split on visa go-slow to curb foreign students
n3cf4318d23.summary: Universities in Australia have divided over a plan to prioritise student visas for a limited number of applicants. The move would slow the processing of international student visas for tertiary education.
n3cf4318d23.why: International student fees are a major revenue source for Australian universities, so visa policy directly affects the sector's finances.

nd6a52ba8bf.headline: Productivity slump worsens Australia's deficit dilemma
nd6a52ba8bf.summary: Australia needs to restore productivity growth to pay for structural spending increases and avoid persistent deficits. The point is made in a commentary on the nation's fiscal position.
nd6a52ba8bf.why: Productivity growth determines long-run economic capacity and tax revenue, which shapes government deficits and bond supply.

n678ad3e5a4.headline: Ireland embraced data centers that the AI boom needs. Now they're consuming too much of its energy
n678ad3e5a4.summary: Dozens of large data centres in Ireland are consuming more electricity than all of the country's urban homes. The strain is beginning to test the welcome that drew them there.
n678ad3e5a4.why: Data centres are major power consumers for cloud and AI providers, and grid capacity constraints can affect where and when new facilities can be built.

ndfd0e9850d.headline: Rural residents to not reel from 12 percent VAT: ministry
ndfd0e9850d.summary: Indonesia's government plans to raise the value-added tax from 11% to 12% next year. The ministry said the increase will not pose a threat to the economy of rural areas.
ndfd0e9850d.why: Value-added tax changes affect consumer prices and household spending, and they influence government revenue. Indonesia is Southeast Asia's largest economy.

n167951609f.headline: Gold rate drops locally as global prices decline – Latest update, December 19, 2024
n167951609f.summary: Local gold prices fell as global prices declined, while the price of silver per tola rose by Rs50 to Rs3,350.
n167951609f.why: Gold is a benchmark store of value, and local prices in Pakistan track global bullion prices adjusted for the rupee. Moves matter for jewellery demand and inflation hedging.

nb654d5b564.headline: Ria Money Transfer partners with Tenpay Global, enabling digital remittances to Weixin for flexible spending in China
nb654d5b564.summary: Ria Money Transfer and Tenpay Global have formed a partnership to enable digital remittances to Weixin, boosting cross-border payment access between China and the rest of the world.
nb654d5b564.why: Ria is a global money transfer company, and Tenpay is the payments arm of Tencent. Cross-border remittance partnerships expand fee-based payment volumes for both firms.

nddf8717b3c.headline: Sri Lanka’s CEB borrows US$150mn ADB loan to fix grid for renewables
nddf8717b3c.summary: State-run Ceylon Electricity Board signed a $150 million loan with the Asian Development Bank. The funds will upgrade its grid to accommodate more renewable energy.
nddf8717b3c.why: Ceylon Electricity Board is Sri Lanka's state power utility, and grid investment determines how much renewable generation the system can absorb.

n911bd78c6e.headline: December 19: Sensex slumps 964 points after the US Federal Reserve's hawkish stance on rate cuts
n911bd78c6e.summary: Indian equity indices closed lower on Thursday amid weak global cues. The Fed's hawkish stance halved the number of expected 2025 rate cuts.
n911bd78c6e.why: The BSE Sensex is India's benchmark stock index, tracking the country's largest listed companies.
n911bd78c6e.why_moved: Weak global cues followed the US Federal Reserve's hawkish stance, with the FOMC halving its expected number of 2025 rate cuts.

n4dfbc42eec.headline: H.I.G. Realty Invests to Become Majority Shareholder in The Grounds, a Leading German Real Estate Development Company
n4dfbc42eec.summary: H.I.G. Capital, an alternative investment firm with $67 billion under management, announced it will become majority shareholder in The Grounds, a German real estate development company.
n4dfbc42eec.why: H.I.G. Capital is a global private equity and alternative investment firm, and majority stakes in property developers signal private capital flowing into European real estate.

neb0e6856fb.headline: Laxmi India Finance files DRHP with Sebi for IPO
neb0e6856fb.summary: Jaipur-based non-banking financial company Laxmi India Finance has filed its draft red herring prospectus with SEBI for an IPO comprising a fresh issue and an offer for sale.
neb0e6856fb.why: A draft red herring prospectus is the initial filing for an Indian public offering; non-banking lenders focused on MSME and vehicle loans are a segment watched by credit investors.

nd8d921cb4a.headline: Carbios:  plant project postponed, stock stalls
nd8d921cb4a.summary: Carbios shares fell almost 30% on the Paris stock exchange after the company said construction of its PET plastic biorecycling plant would be postponed pending receipt of funding.
nd8d921cb4a.why: Carbios is a French biotechnology company developing enzymatic technology to recycle PET plastic. Its share price is sensitive to project timelines and financing for its industrial plants.
nd8d921cb4a.why_moved: The share drop followed the announcement that construction of the plant would be postponed pending receipt of funding.

n465fe6bf47.headline: 12% VAT will not affect fuel prices: Minister Lahadalia
n465fe6bf47.summary: Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Bahlil Lahadalia said the increase in value-added tax from 11% to 12% will not affect fuel prices.
n465fe6bf47.why: Value-added tax changes affect consumer prices and government revenue, and fuel prices feed into inflation and energy subsidy costs in Indonesia.

n79d2e47ef5.headline: Afreximbank signs private sector DRC hydropower project agreement
n79d2e47ef5.summary: Afreximbank signed a project preparation financing agreement for an up to 200 MW private-sector hydropower project on the Lufira river in the DRC. The bank partners with Kipay Investments.
n79d2e47ef5.why: Afreximbank is a African multilateral lender that finances trade and infrastructure, and hydropower projects bring power supply to growing economies.

nfff9f1d92e.headline: Infosys Achieves Binding Corporate Rules Certification from EU Data Protection Authorities
nfff9f1d92e.summary: Infosys has achieved Binding Corporate Rules certification from EU data protection authorities, the company said in a release dated December 19, 2024. The certification covers the handling of personal data across its operations.
nfff9f1d92e.why: Infosys is a major Indian IT services exporter, and EU data transfer approvals matter for its European clients.

n3d59581c04.headline: Dovish BoE dents buoyant sterling but soothes battered gilts
n3d59581c04.summary: A dovish Bank of England message on Thursday dented sterling, one of the year's best performers against the dollar. Two-year gilt yields pulled back from seven-month peaks.
n3d59581c04.why: The Bank of England sets UK interest rates, and its guidance drives sterling and government bond yields.
n3d59581c04.why_moved: The Bank of England's dovish message reduced expectations for tighter policy, which weighed on sterling. Lower expected rates eased pressure on battered government bonds.

n822b841b0a.headline: IReit Global inks lease agreement with second hospitality company in less than a month
n822b841b0a.summary: IReit Global signed a new lease with Stayery, its second hospitality deal in less than a month. The deal supports its plan to reposition Berlin office property into multi-let, mixed-use assets.
n822b841b0a.why: IReit Global is a Singapore-listed real estate investment trust, and leasing deals affect its occupancy and income.

n600c54e532.headline: BT defeats £1.3bn class action case claiming it overcharged customers
n600c54e532.summary: BT has successfully defended a £1.3 billion class action lawsuit alleging it overcharged landline customers. The case was brought against the telecom firm.
n600c54e532.why: BT Group is the UK's largest broadband and telecom provider, and large class actions can create significant legal and financial liabilities.

ne80f8a938b.headline: Sinopec forecasts China's petroleum consumption to peak by 2027
ne80f8a938b.summary: Sinopec said it expects China's petroleum consumption to peak by 2027 as diesel and gasoline demand weakens, and noted the incoming Trump administration.
ne80f8a938b.why: Sinopec is China's largest refiner and petrochemical producer, so its demand outlook shapes expectations for crude imports and refining margins.

nd940d9a09d.headline: Digital Competition Bill faces potential delay as House Panel revisits digital framework
nd940d9a09d.summary: A parliamentary review may delay enactment of the Digital Competition Bill, raising concerns about a postponed regulatory framework for digital markets.
nd940d9a09d.why: India's digital competition rules would govern how large technology platforms operate in one of the world's fastest-growing internet markets.

nfe5c79e38f.headline: Australian government to utilise legal workaround to limit international student numbers
nfe5c79e38f.summary: The Australian government will use a legal workaround to limit international student numbers, local media reported.
nfe5c79e38f.why: International student enrolments are a significant export earner for Australian universities. Caps on student numbers affect education providers, housing demand and government revenue.

n5b8645990c.headline: Indonesian arm of Malaysia’s Mr DIY climbs on market debut
n5b8645990c.summary: The Indonesian arm of Malaysia-based home improvement retailer Mr DIY Group rose on its stock market debut on Thursday, after a wobbly start. The listing took place on December 19.
n5b8645990c.why: Mr DIY Group is a Malaysian home improvement retailer operating across Southeast Asia, and its Indonesian listing is a test of regional retail demand.

n58d3a8207c.headline: Gold rises Rs1,000 on global fluctuations
n58d3a8207c.summary: Gold rose Rs1,000 on global fluctuations, while the rupee closed at Rs278.23 per dollar in the interbank market. The Pakistan Stock Exchange witnessed a sharp decline.
n58d3a8207c.why: Gold is a traditional store of value that often rises during global uncertainty, and the rupee-dollar rate shapes local gold prices in Pakistan.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Local gold prices in Pakistan rose on global price fluctuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

ndf532552d2.headline: Morgan Stanley, others pick stake in Concord Enviro ahead of Rs 500 cr IPO
ndf532552d2.summary: Morgan Stanley Asia (Singapore) and Societe Generale emerged as prominent foreign institutional investors in the anchor bidding round of Concord Enviro Systems, ahead of its Rs 500 crore IPO.
ndf532552d2.why: Anchor investors commit capital before a public offering and their participation is often read as a signal of institutional interest in the listing.

n8397768a93.headline: Stock market today: Wall Street ends little changed after giving up a big morning gain
n8397768a93.summary: An early rebound for U.S. stocks faded by the end of the trading day, leaving major indexes close to flat.
n8397768a93.why: Wall Street indexes such as the S&P 500 track the performance of large U.S. listed companies and are widely used as barometers of market sentiment.

n3c1de00846.headline: Sri Lanka lifts vehicles import ban for first time in 4 years
n3c1de00846.summary: Sri Lanka will allow vehicle imports again after a ban in place since 2020. Personal car imports resume in February 2025, and importers must sell vehicles within three months.
n3c1de00846.why: Vehicle import restrictions affect trade flows, government tax revenue and foreign-exchange demand, and they shape the automotive retail sector in the country.

n14248fac0b.headline: Hydro One expands transmission ownership in northern Ontario
n14248fac0b.summary: Hydro One Networks Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Hydro One Limited, agreed to purchase an approximately 48 per cent interest in transmission ownership in northern Ontario, the company said.
n14248fac0b.why: Hydro One is Ontario's largest electricity transmission and distribution utility, so its acquisitions of grid assets affect its regulated earnings base and capital spending.

n6310e48724.headline: Toronto Stocks Slip; Vermilion Energy Rises on Rosy 2025 Outlook, Dividend Hike
n6310e48724.summary: Toronto stocks were lower mid-session Thursday after a Fed drop, but Vermilion Energy rose on a positive 2025 outlook and a dividend increase.
n6310e48724.why: Vermilion Energy is a Calgary-based oil and gas producer, and its outlook and dividend policy matter to income-focused energy investors.

n5ccf1be3e2.headline: ICE Canola Stronger, Corrects Off Nearby Lows
n5ccf1be3e2.summary: ICE canola futures strengthened and corrected off nearby lows, as traders saw recent losses as overdone. The most-active March contract was back above C$600 per metric ton.
n5ccf1be3e2.why: Canola is an oilseed grown widely on the Canadian Prairies, and ICE canola futures trade in Winnipeg as a benchmark for the crop.

n241c54c99e.headline: Bank of Japan holds rates steady; Yen falls
n241c54c99e.summary: The Bank of Japan left interest rates unchanged at 0.25%, in line with expectations. The yen fell to a one-month low after the decision.
n241c54c99e.why: The Bank of Japan sets Japan's policy rate, which drives yen exchange rates and global carry-trade flows.
n241c54c99e.why_moved: The hold at 0.25% was in line with expectations, but the yen still weakened to a one-month low.
